goal: A store factory in flywheel-orchestrator builds SqliteStore or PostgresStore from WorkPolicy (resolving the postgres DSN from FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN then DATABASE_URL) and replaces every direct SqliteStore construction in the orchestrator command paths.

references: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_workflow.py:649-675 -- resolve_db_path shows the flag > policy > default precedence pattern the factory sits behind
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_postgres.py:47-57 -- reuse this ImportError message when the postgres extra is missing
constraints: FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN wins over DATABASE_URL silently; with neither set and backend=postgres, fail fast with a message naming both vars (spec FR-8)
Import store_postgres lazily inside the postgres branch so the extra stays optional; surface the install command uv add 'flywheel[postgres]' when the import fails
Pass policy store_schema through to PostgresStore(schema=...); pool sizing stays at code defaults
DSN values must never appear verbatim in error messages or logs (password never; host/db name acceptable)

Direct SqliteStore( construction sites to route through the factory: _workflow.py lines 682, 1176, 1304, 1423, 1487, 1516 and _orchestrate.py line 536; after this task only the factory module may construct stores in this package
sqlite backend (or absent policy) must behave byte-for-byte as today: same SqliteStore(db_path) with the same resolved path
Postgres integration tests may use the existing Postgres test container fixture in the root conftest.py
Commit with a Conventional Commits message (feat:) before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not touch flywheel-worktree or the flywheel package (worker/TUI land in store-factory-consumers)
Do not modify flywheel-core; both stores already exist
edge_cases: backend=postgres, extra installed, env var set but DB unreachable -> the store's own connection error propagates; the factory only resolves and constructs
DATABASE_URL set to a non-postgres scheme -> clear connection failure, not a silent sqlite fallback
